RobotProfile Runtime Capability Model
nodes.rationale: Replaces hardcoded C# constants with runtime capability models derived from the website catalog, enabling dynamic multi-robot control without code changes.

nodes.label: Brand-Agnostic Product Positioning
nodes.rationale: Positions OhhO as universal robotics infrastructure across all hardware vendors rather than locked to specific brands.

nodes.label: Hardware-Agnostic Infrastructure Principle
nodes.rationale: Allows users to size compute and choose onboard PCs, GPUs, and headsets freely without hardcoded vendor requirements.

nodes.label: ROS-Optional Runtime Architecture
nodes.rationale: Allows lightweight pure-Python robotics applications to run without ROS overhead while supporting full ROS 2 stacks via unified RAL.

nodes.label: Engine Runtime Port Isolation
nodes.rationale: Engines depend strictly on runtime ports and transport interfaces, preventing hard dependencies on specific middleware or serial libraries.
